detailed_description:
The target video is a living aged tempera painting in <Subject 1>: the cracked pigment and dry-brush texture stay visible on every surface as it moves, and the light changes like paint glazing over paint.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The leaves around the mural sway gently in the wind, sunlight flickering over the painted musicians. The camera tilts up at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move, the mural sliding down out of the frame while the huge leaves and hanging vines of the canopy rise into view and part to open the sky. A flock of white birds lifts off the treetops and rises through the center into the pale blue morning. The camera is still tilting up as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
